mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies and 56 degree temperatures at Verona Community Park, with a waxing gibbous moon overhead.

The City Clerk is hosting an I Voted sticker contest for K-12 students. Submissions close July 22, and the community will vote on the top designs from July 28 through August 7 to decide what voters will receive in November.

There is plenty to do with live music happening today at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by the Dane County Farmer's Market tomorrow and the Paddy Mac's music series starting tomorrow.
In our weekly police report, on July 13, an officer assisted a driver whose vehicle was stuck on a rock, which resulted in the driver being arrested for an O-W-I.

Today's flavor is the fan-favorite Chocolate Volcano. The store is currently closed, but you can head over when they open at 10 AM to grab a treat, or wait for tomorrow when the flavor of the day switches to Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough.
